minimal_conflicting_set.description: The SE-Comp B lab block runs four batch labs at once - OS with AGN, DAA with NR, CCN with JS and PCS with DN - and all four must share one slot of two consecutive teaching periods.

Only three lab rooms are free on Monday from 10.00 to 12.00: 702-A, 702-B and 603-2. Room 608 is held by the TE-Comp A CCN lab, and room 606 is still recorded as 'unsure' in the room inventory so it cannot be allocated.
The DAA lab exam for SE Comp, invigilated by NR, holds Friday 14.15 to 16.15 - the only other slot of the week with four free lab rooms.

suggested_relaxation.description: Classify room 606 as a lab. The room inventory records its usage as 'unsure', so it is currently withheld from lab allocation; confirming it gives SE-Comp B a fourth lab room on Monday at 10.00 and all four batch labs then fit.
